description: Managed Nextcloud changes: connect (one time; repeat until state is connected, about a minute), create_user (userId, optional displayName, email, sendInvite, quota like "10 GB" or "none", isAdmin), update_user (userId with displayName, email or quota), reset_password (userId), set_enabled (userId, enabled), set_admin (userId, isAdmin), delete_user (userId; removes their files), set_default_quota (quota), set_smtp (from, host, port, secure ssl|tls or empty, username, password; portal only) or clear_smtp. sendInvite with an email asks Nextcloud to mail a set-password link and still returns a password once. New and reset passwords are generated by Lanetti and returned once. The main admin account cannot be disabled, deleted or reset here. Returns a proposal; oma_confirm_tool runs it. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

action.description: What to do; the tool description lists each action.

enabled.description: true turns it on, false off.

quota.description: Storage limit, e.g. "10 GB", or "none" for no limit.

sendInvite.description: create_user: email a set-password link when email is set. A password is still returned.

name: oma_manage_nextcloud
title: Manage Nextcloud
